messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

You can now enter a **Deal name** before exporting a snapshot. Loading that snapshot restores the name and progress. New games, restarts, size changes, and board-code loads clear the name.

Pasted snapshots also load when their JSON fields appear in a different order. Unnamed snapshots continue to use version 1, and named snapshots use version 2.

Validation passed: type checking, all 142 unit tests, and all 79 browser tests. The changed files pass formatting; the repository-wide formatting check still reports 13 unchanged files.
